title: Funnie
description: A resource pack That Makes Some Changes for the quality of life.
body:
This Pack Changes Several Things: 
- It switches The Water And Lava Bucket along With There Names To Match Ther Textur. 
- It adds Numbers To The HotBar And A Dsrker GUI. 
- It Also Renamed The Creative Tabs To Random Semi Related Stuff. 
- Gives Axalots A Smily Face. 
- Makes The Totome Of Undying Into A Uno Revers Card. 
- Gives Bread A Face. 
- Makes Bottle o' enchanting a splash bottle. 
- Makes Spawn Eggs Summaning Eggs. 
- Added Stuff To see how full a caldrin is, arrows on dispencers and dropers, arrows on hoppers ond observers, notes on note block, and a hole in the middle of scafulding
